page.overview:
What is Morgulduin?

Morgulduin was a river of Ithilien, which began in the Ephel Dúath and flowed through the Morgul Vale, under the ghastly bridge that led into Minas Morgul, and eventually into the Anduin. Because it originated in the Morgul Vale, it was icy-cold and its waters were polluted and not safe to drink from. According to , the river was less than twenty-five miles in length.

Before the fall of Minas Ithil in TA 2002 the river was known as the Ithilduin.

In the year TA 3019, Faramir warned Frodo and Sam not to drink from it, as the water was tainted and would harm whoever imbibed it.

The Morgulduin appears, though it is not named, in Peter Jackson's as a wide, polluted river adjacent to the causeway of Minas Morgul. It is also labeled on a map of Mordor created for the cinematic lore of by New Line Cinema cartographer, Daniel Reeve.
